name: Governed Ad Platform Executor
description: Launchable MCP executor for exact control-plane-authorized Google Ads and DV360 mutations with state revalidation, serialization, receipts, reconciliation, and rollback.

operational.connected_system: Google Ads API v25 and Display & Video 360 API v4
capabilities: Preview closed provider-native change plans without acquiring execution authority.
Re-read current state and atomically claim an exact short-lived control-plane grant at the effect boundary.
Serialize each provider resource and apply bounded status, budget, or bid updates.
Persist authenticated intents and receipts, verify post-write state, and reconcile ambiguous effects.
Apply a verified rollback patch only under a separate exact rollback grant.
auth_required: Runtime-owned provider credential and closed executor policy
Separately installed Agent Control Plane with an executor identity and grant public key
Private local executor and control-plane stores with independent audit keys
operational.approval_boundary: Mutations require an exact single-use control-plane grant; rollback requires a separate exact grant. Preview never grants execution authority.

requires_setup: Node.js 22 or newer and the Agent Control Plane 0.2.1 package.
Provider OAuth access with Google Ads or DV360 mutation permission for explicitly allowlisted sandbox targets.
Runtime-owned executor policy, credential, signed executor identity, public grant key, stores, and audit keys.
limitations: Only campaign status, campaign-budget amount, ad-group status or CPC bid, and DV360 line-item status or max-average-CPM bid are supported.
Provider mutation APIs do not guarantee idempotency; ambiguous outcomes stop for reconciliation rather than replay.
Conflicting post-write state is never overwritten automatically; it requires reconciliation and a separately authorized rollback where appropriate.
CI uses deterministic provider simulations; live sandbox mutation evidence remains separately gated.
usability.quickstart: Configure sandbox allowlists and the executor identity, preview a closed plan, then execute only the exact control-plane grant for that plan.

authentication.credential_storage: Provider and control-plane credentials remain in runtime-owned bindings. The package stores authenticated plans, state snapshots, and receipt references, never tokens.
authentication.validation: The driver verifies the pinned control-plane install receipt and tree, signed executor authority, complete control-plane audit chain, and a read-only probe against the first allowlisted provider-native target.
authentication.revocation: Revoke provider OAuth access, replace the executor identity or policy, rotate audit keys, and stop executors that trust the former grant key.
